description: Generated by scripts/gen_layer_fixtures.py (M3-T2a); the op contracts and the decisions behind the expectations are in tests/data/surface/layers/README.md. M3 layer analysis (findLayers), Pt(111): p(3×3) 4L in four placements along c, shuffled and T T F, the directions and tolerances, the errors of M3 §3.16, CO on top and in an fcc hollow, the shared CONTCAR (acceptance S14-3) and a jittered CONTCAR-like copy with two CO, CO 6-8 Å above the slab, vacuum along a, bulk Pt along c / (111) / an irrational vector, a cluster without a cell, partial occupancy, adsorbates on the bottom side and the 216-atom p(6×6) 6L slab.

cases.note: M3 §7.1: 4 rows of 9, spacing a/sqrt(3) = 2.2632 Å, the same rows atom by atom in the four placements (centred, bottom at 0, bottom at -0.01 Å, across the cell boundary)
